conditions.condition_text: Use the 9:30 AM candle (NY Stock Exchange open) on the 15-minute timeframe to set the trading range.
The 9:30 AM candle defines the high and low for the day's trading range.
Wait for the candle to break and close above the range and also through the 200 period EMA trend line.
This confirms a market reversal and bullish bias.
Wait for price to tap the top of the range, which acts as support along with the demand zone.
Tapping the top of the range provides a high-probability entry point.
Enter the trade upon price tapping the top of the range/demand zone.
The price action confirms the support level is holding.
The candle must break and close above the range and through the 200 period EMA trend line.
The price has had many touches of the 200 period EMA trend line.
Multiple fair value gaps are present, indicating strong buyers at the level.
The stop is placed below the demand/range support level.
The target is set at the top of the range.
